items.description:
One snapshot per subsystem and station (ADR 0006), the body of `SubsystemCapacityChanged`. Branch on
`subsystem_kind`: `buffer_limit`, `occupied` and `queue_depth` are meaningful only for STATION (0
elsewhere); never sum `units_available` or `open_work` across kinds.

| Field | AMR_FLEET (FleetCapacityChanged) | ASRS (AsrsCapacityChanged) | STATION (its queue) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subsystem_id` | `fleet_id` | `asrs_id` | station id |
| `units_total` | `robots_total` (0 accepted) | `units_total` (0 accepted, never sent) | `buffer_limit` |
| `units_available` = idle-and-dispatchable | `robots_available` (idle, assignable and above the charge threshold; a robot runs one leg at a time) | `units_available` (not HELD; an aisle unit queues jobs) | `buffer_limit - occupied` (min 0) |
| `open_work` = queued + active | `legs_queued + legs_active` | `open_jobs` (queued and executing) | `occupied + waiting` |
| `status` UNAVAILABLE | `robots_online` = 0 (includes `robots_total` 0) | `units_available` = 0 | never |
| `status` DEGRADED | available < total | available < total | arrivals wait upstream |
| `capacity_per_hour` | available x `legsPerRobotHour` (30) | available x `retrievalsPerUnitHour` (60) | 0 |
| `buffer_limit`, `occupied`, `queue_depth` | 0 | 0 | the queue's |
| `measured_at` | this context's clock | this context's clock | this context's clock |

Negative counts clamp to 0.
